scope: The 33 planned labs in the existing Biology main catalog; supplementary activities and already available labs are excluded.
reviewScope: Development acceptance against the documented build guide; classroom, qualified-user, hardware, and production release acceptance remain explicitly separate.
localizationScope: G18 preparation is required in each build. Native language switching and translated print delivery remain planned AUD-10 work; do not claim Spanish readiness from an English build.

checklist.title: Learning evidence
checklist.requirement: Define the question, two to four learning goals, misconceptions, and observable/written evidence for each goal.

checklist.title: Purposeful controls and repetition
checklist.requirement: Justify every condition, control, sample, and trial. Streamline repeated preparation without copying observations or inventing independence.

checklist.title: Scientific accuracy
checklist.requirement: Check mechanisms, quantities, locations, conclusions, questions, and model rules against relevant primary/institutional sources. Resolve disputed claims.

checklist.title: Model limits
checklist.requirement: Explain simplifications, supplied data, accelerated time, uncertainty, and the limits of conclusions where they matter.

checklist.title: Meaningful interaction
checklist.requirement: Students manipulate, measure, classify, or make decisions that cause visible changes and provide evidence of learning. Navigation clicks alone do not pass.

checklist.title: Realistic visuals and geometry
checklist.requirement: Review convincing apparatus/specimens and plausible motion at starting, intermediate, and final states. Verify target alignment after resize, scroll, and reload.

checklist.title: Fair choices and hints
checklist.requirement: Avoid answers given by order or decoration; preserve biological order and stable per-attempt choices.

checklist.title: Ninth-grade wording
checklist.requirement: Review all authored directions, vocabulary, questions, labels, hints, errors, feedback, and handouts. Explain necessary terms. Keep student answers verbatim.

checklist.title: Prediction and checkpoint gates
checklist.requirement: Required thinking is explicitly labeled and enforced before the relevant action. Do not reveal the next-step instruction before its prediction/checkpoint.

checklist.title: Correctness and corrective feedback
checklist.requirement: Show explicit correct/incorrect status, a scientific explanation, and a usable correction path. Preserve meaningful revisions.

checklist.title: Truthful saving
checklist.requirement: Show nearby confirmation only after a successful save; verify repeated completion clicks, denied storage, failure/retry, and honest device/account messages.

checklist.title: Work preservation
checklist.requirement: Restore partial/completed attempts, keep stable IDs, preserve prior work, and invalidate stale completion after substantive edits.

checklist.title: Required PDF and print
checklist.requirement: Provide completed student PDF download and native print, optional name/period, safe named/unnamed filenames, and readable export date/time/time zone.

checklist.title: Learning-focused reports
checklist.requirement: Include actual predictions, data and units/sources, goal-level evidence, corrections, checked answers, original explanations, and model limits rather than a click log.

checklist.title: Report/resource fidelity
checklist.requirement: Compare PDF, native print, and structured snapshots. Render short/long, draft/completed reports and handouts; inspect Unicode, fonts, tables, page breaks, and applicable first-offline PDF output.

checklist.title: Accessible interaction
checklist.requirement: Check mouse, touch, select/place, keyboard, focus, contrast, reduced motion, target sizes, and phone/tablet/desktop layout. Keep hardware testing separate from emulation.

checklist.title: Meaningful validation
checklist.requirement: Run appropriate model, workflow, build, resource/cache, and relevant regression checks. Record actual commands, outcomes, failures/fixes, and artifact paths.

checklist.title: Localization readiness
checklist.requirement: Keep authored content translatable with stable IDs and original responses. Document app/report/resource locale needs and actual language availability. Full Spanish/other-language delivery remains future AUD-10 work unless explicitly included and validated.

checklist.title: Student and teacher materials
checklist.requirement: Supply matching student worksheets/collector sheets and teacher guidance where appropriate, with reviewed modes, prompts, controls, units, source notes, and limitations. Explain any virtual-only scope.

checklist.title: Platform access and release behavior
checklist.requirement: Verify guest/free lab access and reports, manual public sharing/favorites, trial/paid teaching features, enrolled-student assignment access, owner previews, immutable versions, and publication controls as applicable. Do not publish production content as a side effect of acceptance.

checklist.title: Catalog and curriculum integrity
checklist.requirement: Preserve stable IDs and correct units/modes/routes. Update actual implementation/resource records and regenerate/sync dataset outputs only when their sources change. Do not infer standards approval, translated readiness, or whole-course completion.
